items.title: Mastercard (MA) Signs Up For Live AI Commerce Pilot Testing
items.summary: Mastercard (NYSE:MA) and Debia signed a Memorandum of Understanding to pilot AI driven agentic commerce solutions. The pilot links Mastercard's global payment network with Debia's merchant ecosystem for AI powered consumer and merchant interactions. The collaboration aims to test how AI agents can handle discovery, ordering, and payment flows across digital channels in live environments.
